content: He that despiseth small things shall fall by little and little.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Great catastrophes rarely happen overnight; they are the cumulative harvest of minor compromises, small neglects, and casual disregard for fundamentals.
practicalInsight: Pay meticulous attention to the small details of your craft, commitments, and health today.
reflectionPrompt: What small neglect in your daily routine is slowly undermining your long-term success?
